data.name: Introduction
data.description: A first-touch introduction to a new contact.
data.subject: Introduction from {{sender_name}}
data.body_html:
Hi {{recipient_name}},

I'm {{sender_name}}, reaching out to introduce myself and see whether there's a way we can help you.

Would you be open to a short conversation this week?

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}

data.name: Follow-up
data.description: A gentle follow-up after an earlier message.
data.subject: Following up, {{recipient_name}}
data.body_html:
Hi {{recipient_name}},

I wanted to follow up on my previous note to make sure it didn't get buried. Do you have any questions I can help with?

Happy to find a time that works for you.

Thanks,
{{sender_name}}

data.name: Meeting request
data.description: A request to schedule a call or meeting.
data.subject: Quick call this week, {{recipient_name}}?
data.body_html:
Hi {{recipient_name}},

I'd love to set up a brief call to walk you through how we can help. Would a 20-minute slot this week suit you?

Let me know a couple of times that work and I'll send an invite.

Best,
{{sender_name}}

data.name: Proposal follow-up
data.description: A nudge following a proposal or quote.
data.subject: Your proposal from {{sender_name}}
data.body_html:
Hi {{recipient_name}},

I'm checking in on the proposal I sent over. I'd be glad to clarify anything or adjust it to fit your needs.

What are your thoughts on the next steps?

Kind regards,
{{sender_name}}

data.name: Thank you
data.description: A thank-you note after a call, meeting, or purchase.
data.subject: Thank you, {{recipient_name}}
data.body_html:
Hi {{recipient_name}},

Thank you for your time today — I really enjoyed our conversation. I'll follow up with the details we discussed shortly.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if anything comes up in the meantime.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}

data.name: Check-in
data.description: A re-engagement message for a quiet contact.
data.subject: Checking in, {{recipient_name}}
data.body_html:
Hi {{recipient_name}},

It's been a little while, so I wanted to check in and see how things are going on your end.

If now is a good time to pick things back up, I'm here to help.

All the best,
{{sender_name}}
